C09-M02-L03-F1.title: Hash checkpoints in the C09 acquisition transcript
C09-M02-L03-F1.caption: The six transcript stages, the object hashed at each and how its digest compares with the source reference value.
C09-M02-L03-F1.alt: Table with columns Stage, Object hashed, Digest begins and Outcome. Row 1, dark: suspect.dev source, e3a74e55, reference value. Rows 2 to 4, green: evidence.dd stream, evidence.dd file of 16,777,216 bytes, and working.dd, each beginning e3a74e55 and equal to the reference. Row 5, red: working.dd after a one-byte edit, beginning 16d816db, differs, cmp reports char 100001. Row 6, slate: evidence.dd MD5, beginning 93308050, a different algorithm that is not compared with the SHA-256 rows.
C09-M02-L03-F1.note: Prefixes are for reading the figure only; a real verification compares all 64 characters.

C09-M02-L03-F2.title: Responding to a hash mismatch
C09-M02-L03-F2.caption: A fixed order of checks that moves from the commonest explanation to the most serious, without altering any record.
C09-M02-L03-F2.alt: Decision graph. Red start node: recomputed digest does not equal the record. It leads to the violet question Like-for-like comparison? If not comparable, the slate outcome Transcription or format error: fix the comparison and note it. If a true mismatch, the violet question Size equals record? If size differs, the orange outcome Incomplete or damaged copy: recopy from the verified master. If size is equal, the violet question Master copy still matches? If the master matches, the orange outcome Only this copy altered: quarantine it and make a new copy. If the master differs, the dark outcome Master no longer matches: stop, preserve and escalate.

nodes.label: Only this copy altered
nodes.sub: quarantine it; make a new copy

C09-M02-L03-F2.note: Never overwrite a recorded value to make it match; every finding goes into the case notes.
